about: Each way of ending ST-LINK_gdbserver 7.14.0 under a GDB session on the reference board, cycle after cycle, recorded by tests/bench/st_link_gdbserver_recordings.py (the ends rounds), with whether the core kept still over the end and whether the next server start and the next STM32_Programmer_CLI call were answered. `shared_sigkill` ran the server with -t through stlink-server 2.1.1, which these rounds started and ended with SIGTERM.
